build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Explore at least three connected districts or territories from Winchester Circuit, each with distinct opportunities, hazards, and ownership state. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences in one playable flow.
